text:
Which description of condensation is correct?
A
a gas changing into a liquid as its molecules lose energy
B
a gas changing into a liquid as its molecules gain energy
C
a liquid changing into a gas as its molecules lose energy
D
a liquid changing into a gas as its molecules gain energy

options.label: A
options.text: a gas changing into a liquid as its molecules lose energy

options.label: B
options.text: a gas changing into a liquid as its molecules gain energy

options.label: C
options.text: a liquid changing into a gas as its molecules lose energy

options.label: D
options.text: a liquid changing into a gas as its molecules gain energy
